marks.gloss_en: כדאמר להו רבי יהושע בן לוי לבניה: אשלימו פרשיותייכו עם הצבור -- as RYbL told his sons: with the congregation, not before or after
R' Yehoshua ben Levi to his sons: complete your portions with the congregation, twice Scripture and once Targum

ומשום מעשה דרב פפא -- Rav Pappa would not sit on the Aramean woman's bed until she lifted it, and a dead infant was found there; מכאן אמרו חכמים אסור לישב על מטת ארמית (an incident, not a svara: no support kind exists for a מעשה)
from the incident the Sages said: it is forbidden to sit on the bed of an Aramean woman (Rav Pappa would not sit until she lifted the bed, and a dead infant was found beneath it)
ואל תעברו אחורי בית הכנסת בשעה שהצבור מתפללין -- מסייע ליה לרבי יהושע בן לוי: Rava's instruction to his sons says what RYbL rules
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: a person may not pass behind the synagogue while the congregation is praying

תנא ליה: כתיב ועניתם את נפשותיכם בתשעה לחודש בערב... כל האוכל ושותה בתשיעי מעלה עליו הכתוב כאילו מתענה תשיעי ועשירי -- eating and drinking on the ninth is itself credited as fasting; (Rashi / Steinsaltz: so the eve of Yom Kippur is given over to eating, not to catching up on the year's portions)
(entertained) Rav Bivi bar Abaye's plan: complete the whole year's portions on the eve of Yom Kippur

אמר ליה ההוא סבא, תנינא: ובלבד שלא יקדים ולא יאחר -- one reads with the congregation, neither in advance nor in arrears (marker תנינא; the clause is tannaitic but not in the Mishnah, hence kind tanya)
(entertained) Rav Bivi's second plan: read the portions in advance of the congregation
even a verse of bare place-names such as 'Atarot and Divon' (Num 32:3) is read twice and its Targum once

'you shall afflict your souls on the ninth of the month at evening' (Lev 23:32) -- yet one fasts on the tenth; rather the verse tells you: whoever eats and drinks on the ninth, Scripture credits him as though he fasted on the ninth and the tenth
and be careful with the veins [in slaughtering a bird], in accordance with R' Yehuda
and be careful [to honour] an elder who forgot his learning through duress
Rava to his sons: when you cut meat, do not cut it on the hand
Rava: and do not sit on the bed of an Aramean woman
Abaye: we said this only where there is no other entrance [to the synagogue]
Rav Yehuda in Shmuel's name: the halakha follows Rabban Gamliel
'I have commanded My consecrated ones' (Isa 13:3) -- these are the Persians
מאי קראה -- וישלח יעקב ויקרא לרחל וללאה השדה אל צאנו: Jacob called his wives out to the field to take counsel
Rav Adda bar Ahava: the verse -- 'and Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field, to his flock' (Gen 31:4): he took counsel with them in the field
R' Akiva: in three things I love the Medes
Rabban Gamliel: in three things I love the Persians
הא גופא קשיא: 'twice at night' -- so the span after dawn is night; then 'one of the day and one of the night' -- so it is day!
לא, לעולם ליליא הוא, והא דקרי ליה יום -- דאיכא אינשי דקיימי בההיא שעתא: it is night; it is called day only because some people are already up (= p_achar_amud_laila, p_karei_leih_yom)
the span just after dawn is in truth night
הא גופא קשיא: 'twice by day' -- so the span before sunrise is day; then 'one of the day and one of the night' -- so it is night!
R' Shimon ben Yochai: at times one recites the Shema twice at night, once before dawn and once after dawn, and thereby fulfils one of the day and one of the night
Rav Acha bar Chanina in R' Yehoshua ben Levi's name: the halakha follows R' Shimon ben Yochai (placement 1: the dawn baraita)
R' Shimon ben Yochai in R' Akiva's name: at times one recites the Shema twice by day, once before sunrise and once after sunrise, and thereby fulfils one of the day and one of the night
